is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigated Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s.) collected from breeding sites in Plateau department, Benin (Page 1-2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study characterized the Vgsc kdr L1014F mutation (Vgsc L995F) using PCR (Page 2, 'Molecular analysis').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (Page 6) reports exact kdr L1014F genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and sample sizes for Ifangni, Sakété, Pobè, and Kétou districts pre- (2009) and post-intervention (2012–2013). Table 3 and Table 5 also give genotype counts for bioassay dead/live and species-specific subsets.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from natural breeding sites in 4 districts (Ifangni, Sakété, Pobè and Kétou) in Plateau department, South-East Benin in 2009 and 2012–2013, and reared to adulthood (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article presenting new field collection, bioassay, and genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Sampling was conducted in four specific districts (Ifangni, Sakété, Pobè, and Kétou) in the Plateau Department, Benin (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Sampling periods are explicitly specified: pre-intervention in May–July 2009 and post-intervention in May–July 2012–2013 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports original field collections conducted by CREC in four districts of Plateau department, Benin.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are reported in full within the main text tables (Tables 1–5).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and the frequency of the Vgsc L1014F (kdr-west) mutation in Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s.) across four districts in Plateau Department, south-eastern Benin, before (2009) and after (2012–2013) a 2011 mass LLIN distribution campaign. Detailed kdr L1014F genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) are presented per district, as well as broken down by bioassay outcome (dead vs live post-deltamethrin exposure) and species.
